create_optimizer_for_model: create an optimizer for a PyTorch model using args with opt, lr, weight_decay, and momentum settings
get_parameter_groups_with_decay: get parameter groups from a model separating decay and no_decay params with optional layer-wise lr scaling
assign_layer_decay_for_convnext: assign layer decay values for a ConvNeXt model using LayerDecayValueAssigner with a list of scale values
compute_convnext_layer_id: compute the layer ID for a ConvNeXt parameter name to support layer-wise learning rate decay
create_lookahead_optimizer: create a Lookahead-wrapped optimizer by prefixing the opt name with lookahead_ in the args configuration
